statement: Software on an ordinary suspended, hibernated or fully shut-down computer cannot perform ongoing work without external hardware/OS-supported wake; restoration must be triggered on wake, startup, browser activation or expressly consented supported wake timers.
rationale: Distinguish real service continuity from physically impossible continuous execution; do not disable sleep silently.

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
